discription: A clear, resonant bell-like tone created by combining two slightly detuned sine waves with a short, percussive envelope.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, detune=1.007, pan=0;    var sig1, sig2, sig, env;    env = EnvGen.ar(        Env.perc(0.001, 0.8, curve: -4),        gate: gate,        doneAction: 2    );    sig1 = SinOsc.ar(freq);    sig2 = SinOsc.ar(freq * detune);    sig = (sig1 + sig2) * 0.5 * amp * env;    Out.ar(out, Pan2.ar(sig, pan));}
